item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
First release.
### Added
- StockBar menu bar ticker for VN stocks and crypto - show the running version in the panel header - auto-update via Sparkle, and keep the version in build_app.sh - switches instead of checkboxes, and reorder buttons in edit mode - scale the panel 50% larger through a single factor - scroll a long watchlist, and verify a symbol before adding it - a detail card on hover, with P/E and P/B - float the hover card instead of laying it out - the hover card stays light on both themes - the card takes the app's own background colour
### Fixed
- show prices in full so the menu bar and the popover agree - indices lost their quote after 23:00, dead Refresh button, dead update checkbox - crypto pairs filed as Vietnamese equities never resolved - the scroll knob was drawn on top of the change figures
### Other
- docs: opening an ad-hoc signed download, and the new panel behaviour - style(ui): the settings block reads 20% smaller than the rows - style(ui): the Quit button says Quit - refactor: one directory per layer, and a design system for the panel - test: 53 tests over the pure layer - docs: the layer rules, the design system, and how to prove a layout change - docs(probe): two comments still named the glyph's old entry point - docs: the hover card, the third upstream, and two stale API names - docs: the card floats now, and what that costs the panel
### Install
1. Open the `.dmg` and drag **StockBar** into Applications. 2. The app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized, so Gatekeeper will refuse to open it. Clear the quarantine flag once:
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/StockBar.app ```
3. Launch it. The ticker appears in the menu bar — there is no Dock icon and no window.
Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later. Building from source needs only the Xcode Command Line Tools.
